name: SEO
author: Squilla
description: Owns /robots.txt, SEO defaults (meta title/description/OG/Twitter), and AI-crawler policy. Pairs with sitemap-generator for the full search-engine surface.

settings.title: SEO
settings.description: Search engine and social-card defaults. Per-node SEO settings always win.

sections.title: SEO
sections.description: Site-wide SEO defaults. Per-node SEO settings always win.

fields.label: Default Meta Title
fields.help: Used when a page has no Meta Title set. ≤60 chars recommended.

fields.label: Default Meta Description
fields.help: Fallback meta description. ≤160 chars recommended.

fields.label: Default OG Image
fields.help: Fallback for og:image / twitter:image when a page has no featured image. 1200×630 recommended.

fields.label: OG Site Name
fields.help: Emitted as og:site_name. Falls back to Site Name when blank.

fields.label: Twitter Handle
fields.help: Emitted as twitter:site for cards.

fields.label: Allow search engines to index this site
fields.help: When off, every public page emits noindex,nofollow (and the X-Robots-Tag header). Use OFF during staging.
fields.warning: This setting is per-language. To hide the entire site from search, switch the language picker and toggle this OFF for every active language.

settings.title: Robots & AI Crawlers
settings.description: Controls /robots.txt — what classic search engines and AI crawlers may do with your content. The SEO indexing master switch (Site Settings → SEO) overrides everything here when off.

sections.title: AI Crawler Policy
sections.description: Two distinct cohorts. Training crawlers feed model corpora. Search crawlers fetch live when a user asks an AI assistant.

fields.label: Allow AI training crawlers
fields.help: Off blocks GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, CCBot, Meta-ExternalAgent, Bytespider, Amazonbot, and ~15 other training crawlers.
fields.warning: Training opt-out is best-effort: it relies on each vendor honouring robots.txt. Sticky badges only — no enforcement.

fields.label: Allow AI answer-engine crawlers
fields.help: Off blocks ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, MistralAI-User, DuckAssistBot, etc.

fields.label: Additional Disallow paths
fields.help: One path per line. Appended to the User-agent: * block alongside the built-in /admin, /auth, /api defaults.

fields.label: Custom robots.txt block
fields.placeholder:
# Slow this one bot down
User-agent: SpecialBot
Crawl-delay: 10
fields.help: Appended verbatim at the end. Use for vendor-specific directives, Crawl-delay, or comments.

fields.label: Sitemap URL override
fields.help: Defaults to <site_url>/sitemap.xml. Override if your sitemap lives elsewhere.

settings.title: AI & LLMs
settings.description: Serves /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt, a plain index of your public content for AI assistants. Off on staging automatically when indexing is disabled in SEO.

sections.title: llms.txt
sections.description: Summary and About text sit at the top of the file. Each public node type becomes a section of links. Nodes flagged Exclude from llms.txt in their SEO panel are left out.

fields.label: Publish /llms.txt
fields.help: When off, /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt return 404 and robots.txt drops the LLMs pointer.

fields.label: Summary
fields.placeholder: Defaults to the default meta description
fields.help: One or two sentences at the top of the file, shown as a blockquote. Falls back to Default Meta Description, then Site Description.

fields.label: About
fields.placeholder: Who you are, where you are, what makes you different, what you are not.
fields.help: Free text, included verbatim. Put facts a model should get right here: who runs it, where, group sizes, prices model, what you do not offer.

fields.label: Node types to include
fields.help: Comma-separated type slugs, in the order they should appear. Leave empty to include every public type. Non-public types are always skipped.

fields.label: Items per section
fields.help: Maximum entries listed per node type (1 to 500). Newest first, pages by title.

fields.label: Optional links
fields.help: One per line, as a URL or 'Title | URL'. Listed under ## Optional, which agents may skip. The sitemap is always listed there too.

settings.title: Schema.org
settings.description: Organization and site-wide structured data emitted as a JSON-LD @graph on every public page. Per-page facts come from the page itself.

sections.title: Organization
sections.description: Who runs the site. Feeds the Organization (or subtype) node that WebSite, WebPage and BlogPosting point at.

fields.label: Emit Schema.org structured data
fields.help: When off, no JSON-LD is emitted on any public page.

fields.label: Organization type
fields.help: Most specific schema.org type that fits the business. Person omits address and price range.

fields.label: Legal or brand name
fields.placeholder: Defaults to OG Site Name, then Site Name
fields.help: Name Google and AI engines should attribute the site to.

fields.label: Organization description
fields.help: One or two sentences describing what the business does.

fields.label: Logo URL
fields.help: Square or wide logo, absolute or site-relative URL. Shown in Google Knowledge Panels.

fields.label: Profile links (sameAs)
fields.help: One URL per line: social profiles, Google Business Profile, Wikipedia or Wikidata entries.

fields.label: Telephone
fields.help: Public contact number, international format.

fields.label: Email
fields.help: Public contact email.

fields.label: Street address
fields.help: Leave all address fields blank for businesses without a physical address.

fields.label: Country code
fields.help: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. VN, US, GB.

fields.label: Latitude
fields.help: Decimal degrees. Emitted only together with longitude.

fields.label: Longitude
fields.help: Decimal degrees. Emitted only together with latitude.

fields.label: Price range
fields.help: Rough indication such as $ to $$$$. Not emitted for Person.

fields.label: Area served
fields.help: City or region you serve.
